From f5ef2db5003f3f75a236f9b3ff2d1d4469ca073e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suresh Srinivas <suresh@apache.org>
Date: Sat, 27 Apr 2013 15:44:33 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] HADOOP-9500. TestUserGroupInformation#testGetServerSideGroups
 fails on Windows due to failure to find winutils.exe. Contributed by Chris
 Nauroth.

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/hadoop/common/trunk@1476606 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
index c1611a29dd7..dfc30e4b577 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
@@ -522,6 +522,9 @@ Trunk (Unreleased)
 
     HADOOP-9290. Some tests cannot load native library on windows.
     (Chris Nauroth via suresh)
+
+    HADOOP-9500. TestUserGroupInformation#testGetServerSideGroups fails on 
+    Windows due to failure to find winutils.exe. (Chris Nauroth via suresh)
     
 Release 2.0.5-beta - UNRELEASED
 

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/test/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/TestUserGroupInformation.java b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/test/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/TestUserGroupInformation.java
index fd23e965536..aa40cf48bd9 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/test/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/TestUserGroupInformation.java
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/test/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/TestUserGroupInformation.java
@@ -76,7 +76,9 @@ public static void setup() {
     javax.security.auth.login.Configuration.setConfiguration(
         new DummyLoginConfiguration());
     // doesn't matter what it is, but getGroups needs it set...
-    System.setProperty("hadoop.home.dir", "/tmp");
+    // use HADOOP_HOME environment variable to prevent interfering with logic
+    // that finds winutils.exe
+    System.setProperty("hadoop.home.dir", System.getenv("HADOOP_HOME"));
     // fake the realm is kerberos is enabled
     System.setProperty("java.security.krb5.kdc", "");
     System.setProperty("java.security.krb5.realm", "DEFAULT.REALM");
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **CHANGES.txt**
   - Added a new entry for the bug fix related to HADOOP-9500, which states that the `TestUserGroupInformation#testGetServerSideGroups` test fails on Windows due to the inability to find `winutils.exe`. This entry credits Chris Nauroth for the contribution.

2. **TestUserGroupInformation.java**
   - Modified the `setup()` method to change the way the `hadoop.home.dir` system property is set. Instead of hardcoding it to "/tmp", it now retrieves the value from the `HADOOP_HOME` environment variable. This change is intended to prevent interference with the logic that locates `winutils.exe`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `CHANGES.txt` documents the bug fix introduced in `TestUserGroupInformation.java`. The change in the Java test file addresses the specific issue (HADOOP-9500) mentioned in the CHANGES.txt file, ensuring that the test can run successfully on Windows by correctly setting the `hadoop.home.dir` property to the environment variable `HADOOP_HOME`. This relationship highlights the connection between the documentation of the bug fix and the actual code change that resolves the issue.
